In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IBIS/ISGR1 is performing very well and that the GPS observations are a very valuable contribution to the INTEGRAL mission.
INTEGRAL/ISGRI has performed very well during the GPS operations and that its performances are in good agreement with pre-launch expectations.
the GPS is a very successful and efficient way to perform a systematic survey of the whole sky.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IBIS/ISGR1 is able to detect point-like sources down to the 1.5 mCrab level in the 20 keV energy range and 4 mCrab level at 40 keV.
the IBIS/ ISGRI instrument has performed as expected during this first Galactic Plane Scan.
the IBIS/ ISGRI detector performs very well in the 20 keV 1 MeV energy range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the INTEGRAL/ISGRI instrument has already reached a very good level of performance in terms of spatial resolution and sensitivity.
the IBIS in-orbit performances are fully consistent with the expected performances.
, for the GPS observations, the 20 80 keV IBIS/ISGR1 sensitivity is 1.2 mCrab for a 5 sigma significance.
